title: Subcontractor Compliance
description: Certificates of insurance, lien waivers, and year-end information returns for the people you pay.

setup.prompt: Nothing is enforced yet. Define the counterparty classes and the certificates each one must carry.

panels.blockedEmpty: Nothing is being held. Every open subcontractor bill clears.
panels.expiringEmpty: No certificate is inside its warning window.
panels.waiversHint: Requested or received but not yet signed
panels.waiversEmpty: No waiver is waiting on a signature.
panels.readinessEmpty: Every reportable vendor has what a filing needs.

empty.title: No subcontractors are being tracked yet
empty.description: Assign a compliance class to a vendor to start requiring certificates of it.

reasons.coverage_amount_missing: no limit shown on the certificate

waiverTypeHint.conditional_progress: Releases work through the date only once the payment clears the bank.
waiverTypeHint.unconditional_progress: Releases work through the date immediately — even if the payment is never honoured.
waiverTypeHint.conditional_final: Releases the entire contract, including retention, once final payment clears.
waiverTypeHint.unconditional_final: Releases the entire contract, including retention, immediately and unconditionally.

readiness.unflagged: Paid over the threshold but not flagged reportable

vendors.title: Subcontractor compliance matrix
vendors.description: One row per tracked subcontractor, one column per policy. The same evaluation the pay run performs.

empty.title: No tracked subcontractors match
empty.description: Assign a compliance class on a vendor's Compliance tab to bring it into the matrix.

certificates.empty: Nothing on file for this subcontractor yet.
certificates.recordHint: Recorded as pending review. Someone else has to verify it before it counts.
certificates.noPolicies: No policy applies to this subcontractor's class yet.
certificates.selfVerifyBlocked: A certificate must be verified by someone other than the person who recorded it.

exceptions.intro: An exception is the only way past a blocking requirement. It always expires and is always recorded.
exceptions.grantHint: Maximum 120 days. A longer suspension is a policy change, not an exception.

lienWaivers.title: Lien waivers
lienWaivers.description: Statutory releases exchanged for construction payment — received from subcontractors, issued to owners.

empty.title: No lien waivers yet
empty.description: Create one when you request a release from a subcontractor, or issue one with an application for payment.

lienWaivers.jurisdictionHint: The statute whose form this follows, e.g. US-CA or CA-ON. Printed on the document.
lienWaivers.notesHint: Exceptions and disputed claims printed on the waiver.
lienWaivers.copyFromBill: Copy the amount from a bill…
lienWaivers.recordSignatureHint: Marking a waiver signed is what releases a blocked payment. Only do it once the executed document is in hand.
lienWaivers.executedCopyHint: Attach the scanned signed waiver here. It stays in the File Cabinet and is linked to this record.

errors.partyAndProject: Pick both a party and a project — a lien is a claim against a specific project.

informationReturns.title: Information returns
informationReturns.description: 1099-NEC, 1099-MISC and T4A, computed from the cash you actually paid in the calendar year.

empty.title: No filings yet
empty.description: Open a filing for a completed calendar year and compute it from the ledger.

informationReturns.readinessDescription: Vendors that will make a filing wrong if nobody chases them first.
informationReturns.readinessClear: Every reportable vendor has a TIN and an assigned form.
informationReturns.computed: Computed {count} recipients with {exceptions} exceptions to review.
informationReturns.frozenNotice: This filing is frozen. Amounts and exclusions reflect what was transmitted; corrections go on a new filing.
informationReturns.noRecipients: Nothing computed yet. Compute the filing to trace the year's payments.
informationReturns.adjustDescription: Adjustments are signed deltas against the ledger figure, so the trace is never overwritten.
informationReturns.exclude: Exclude this recipient from the filing
informationReturns.referenceHint: The receipt or submission id the channel returned.
informationReturns.footnote: Amounts are the cash paid in the calendar year, traced through applications to each bill's expense accounts. An asterisk marks a figure a person adjusted.

fields.expiryRequired: This requirement needs an expiry date.
fields.coverageCurrencyHint: Must be {currency} — limits are never converted for comparison.
fields.complianceClassHint: No class means this vendor is not tracked and never blocks a payment.
fields.tinHint: Sealed at rest. Only the last four digits are ever shown again.

errors.pickRequirement: Pick the requirement this certificate satisfies.
errors.exceptionIncomplete: An exception needs a requirement and an end date.
